//: THE §8 CONTROLLED VOCABULARIES AS DATA (docs/PRAETORIA_VOCAB.md v1.1 — LOCKED). Nature traits constrain and bear stress; aptitude traits gate and flavour; ambitions drive NPC AI and personal-story events. Character creation offers exactly these; the Python pre-flight asserts this file matches the locked lists. Add a trait here AND in the vocab doc, then author content that reads it.

nature.name: Ambitious
nature.description: Reaches always for the next rung; unlocks bold, self-advancing options.

nature.name: Arrogant
nature.description: Overrates self, underrates others; aggressive and contemptuous of rivals.

nature.name: Cruel
nature.description: Inflicts more than the situation requires; comfortable with others' pain as a tool.

nature.name: Honorable
nature.description: Keeps oaths and the rules of the game; breaking one spikes stress.

nature.name: Just
nature.description: Weighs fairness over advantage; pays stress to do right when wrong would be easier.

nature.name: Loyal
nature.description: Holds to people and bonds past self-interest; betrayal is near-unthinkable.

nature.name: Proud
nature.description: Will not be slighted; defends standing even at cost; struggles to yield or apologize.

nature.name: Ruthless
nature.description: Removes obstacles by any means; ends justify means without hesitation.

nature.name: Vengeful
nature.description: Remembers every wrong; carries grudges into debts that must be repaid.

aptitude.name: Administrator
aptitude.description: Delegation and institutional options; running things efficiently.

aptitude.name: Brilliant
aptitude.description: Insight options — study, invent, see what others miss.

aptitude.name: Duelist
aptitude.description: Personal-combat options; the blade as answer.

aptitude.name: Greedy
aptitude.description: Tempting corrupt or profitable options others don't see, usually with a corruption cost.

aptitude.name: Orator
aptitude.description: Persuasion of crowds and chambers; winning on the popular, not the sound, argument.

aptitude.name: Quartermaster
aptitude.description: Supply, logistics, keeping a force fed and equipped.

aptitude.name: Schemer
aptitude.description: Indirect, manipulative options; winning by arranging rather than confronting.

aptitude.name: Strategist
aptitude.description: Large-scale planning; doing more with less.

ambitions.name: Amass a Fortune
ambitions.description: Wealth above all — credits, holdings, leverage.

ambitions.name: Command a Fleet
ambitions.description: A fleet of their own to command — the military dream made concrete.

ambitions.name: Earn a Command
ambitions.description: A real command of their own, won by merit.

ambitions.name: Master the Senate
ambitions.description: Political dominance in the chambers of power.

ambitions.name: Outshine All Rivals
ambitions.description: Being recognized as the best, relative to peers.

ambitions.name: Restore the House
ambitions.description: Returning a fallen or diminished house to greatness.

ambitions.name: Win a Great Love
ambitions.description: A personal, romantic, or familial bond above ambition.
